courtship_events.name: A Meal Taken Together
courtship_events.description: Two people carry their trays to the same end of the table without being asked to.

courtship_events.name: The Quiet Walk
courtship_events.description: The last circuit of the fence before lights-out, walked slowly enough to talk.

courtship_events.name: A Long Conversation
courtship_events.description: The account of a life told in the order it comes out rather than the order it happened.

courtship_events.name: A Crafted Gift
courtship_events.description: Something made by hand from salvage that could have been spent on anything else.

courtship_events.name: Keeping Watch Together
courtship_events.description: A long night beside a cot, taken in turns that stop being turns.

courtship_events.name: The Radio Hour
courtship_events.description: Sharing the one working receiver, arguing quietly about which band is worth the battery.

courtship_events.name: The Water Detail
courtship_events.description: Two sets of hands on the same cranks. The work goes faster than the numbers say it should.

courtship_events.name: Cards by Lamplight
courtship_events.description: A deck missing three cards, played for nothing, lasting much longer than the game.

courtship_events.name: Mending What Can Be Mended
courtship_events.description: One sews. The other pretends not to watch. A sleeve is repaired that did not need repairing.

courtship_events.name: The Roof Watch
courtship_events.description: A cold shift above the shelter, shared because neither wanted the other to take it alone.

courtship_events.name: Reading an Old Letter
courtship_events.description: Something written before the crossing, read aloud once, and then folded away again.

courtship_events.name: Rows in the Greenhouse
courtship_events.description: Working opposite ends of the same bed of soil, meeting in the middle more often than the rows require.

courtship_events.name: Half of a Ration
courtship_events.description: A portion quietly split when the ledger says it was not. The ledger is not told.

courtship_events.name: Sitting With the Injured
courtship_events.description: A chair pulled to the end of a ward bed and left there for the whole of a shift.

courtship_events.name: Clearing the Snow
courtship_events.description: Two shovels, one doorway, and a path cleared wider than anyone needed it to be.

courtship_events.name: The Borrowed Instrument
courtship_events.description: A tune played badly and then better, for an audience of exactly one.

courtship_events.name: At the Memorial
courtship_events.description: Standing at the names together, saying less than either expected to, which turns out to be the point.

courtship_events.name: The Long Haul
courtship_events.description: A hard run out and back, where the conversation carries further than the fuel does.

courtship_events.name: Quiet by a Candle
courtship_events.description: No task, no ledger, no reason to be in the same room except the being there.

courtship_events.name: The Salvage Trip
courtship_events.description: Two people into a dead building and two people out, having decided together which risks were worth it.
